nri-world.title: Selling Indian Property to Another NRI? The Buyer Must Still Deduct TDS — at 12.5% or More
nri-world.excerpt: When an NRI sells property in India, the buyer must deduct tax at source under the non-resident rules no matter who the buyer is — there is no Rs 50 lakh threshold and no basic-exemption adjustment for the seller. In Gemini settings, under Connected Apps, disconnect Gmail to stop Gemini reading your mail at all.
